title: Disputing a Dropped-Batch Violation in the Cartwise App — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Rule.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the shopper disputes a dropped-batch violation in the Cartwise app, the app offers the dispute on the most recent dropped-batch violation on the account, and the dispute is decided at once on the records of that violation's batch and of the account: it removes the dropped-batch excusal points from the violation, booked as one cleared entry with removal reason "dispute upheld".

**When the points are fixed.** The points a dropped-batch dispute removes are not fixed until no wrong-address dispute on the account stands submitted and undecided. The points a dropped-batch dispute removes are worked out only after every alcohol-procedure dispute on the account has been decided. Before the points a dropped-batch dispute removes are fixed, every late-delivery dispute on the account must carry a decision.

Read against the account's disputes, the figure stands only when no wrong-address dispute is still submitted and undecided, every alcohol-procedure dispute shows a decision, and every late-delivery dispute shows a decision.

## Tool: `dispute_dropped_batch_violation_598e80dc`

**Capability.** The shopper's own in-app dispute of a dropped-batch violation on their contractor account, settled on the spot: the shopper files the dispute and takes the stated number of violation points off that violation. One call files one violation dispute marked upheld, books one cleared entry against the violation with removal reason `dispute_upheld` and the points removed, and lowers the account's active violation points by the same number.

**How it is invoked.** This is the shopper's own tool. The agent unlocks `dispute_dropped_batch_violation_598e80dc` and hands it over; the shopper — the customer themselves — runs it in the Cartwise app.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `shopper_account_id` | The shopper's own contractor account number, as the agent reads it from the shopper account lookup and passes it to the shopper | Account reference, text |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of the dropped-batch violation entry being disputed, as shown in the shopper account entries lookup and passed to the shopper by the agent | Entry reference, text |
| `points` | The violation points taken off the disputed violation, as the agent tells the shopper | A whole non-negative integer, no decimals, no sign; the active points fall by exactly this integer |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("dispute_upheld" when the dispute was filed and settled), `shopper_appeal_id` (the reference of the new dispute), `clearing_entry_id` (the reference of the new cleared entry), `source_event_id` (echoed back), `points_removed`, `violation_points_balance` (the active violation points afterwards) and `event_date` (the date of the dispute, YYYY-MM-DD). The shopper then sees the dispute as upheld and the lower points total in the app.
